name: vLLM#47159: Triton W4A16 qzeros assertion fails on GPTQ models
notes: GPTQ quantized Qwen 3.6 27B fails with qzeros.shape assertion in triton_w4a16.py. Works on unquantized models. Affects ROCm with TRITON_ATTN backend. Assertion: qzeros.shape == (K // group_size, N // 8). Demonstrates quantization format compatibility issues with Triton kernels.
